sketches.mechanism: Void is an uninhabited type, and absurd can turn an impossible value into any type because it can never actually receive one.
sketches.resonance: From absolute absence, anything follows, but only because absence never arrives.
sketches.draft:
import Data.Void

fromNothing :: Void -> a
fromNothing v = absurd v

sketches.mechanism: call/cc captures the current continuation as a first-class value that can later re-enter the saved control context.
sketches.resonance: A moment keeps its own way back, and calling it makes the present yield to the past.

sketches.mechanism: Negation as failure makes \+ Goal succeed when the interpreter cannot prove Goal.
sketches.resonance: The language mistakes what it cannot find for what is not there.
